issues.explanation: Uses protected rules() plus validate() instead of the project's #[Validate] attribute pattern for the name field.
Custom current_entity middleware on the Dashboard Livewire route is not registered as persistent, so it stops applying on subsequent Livewire update requests.
CreateEntity::submit() does not call authorize() for the create ability, relying on route middleware while the policy allows any authenticated user.
No Livewire unauthorized-call or tamper test for CreateEntity::submit as guest, only HTTP GET guest redirects are asserted.
Same changelog entry duplicated under the released [0.0.0] section instead of only under [Unreleased].

conventions.evidence: Policies used for auth (app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:61, app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:512), $fillable set (app/Models/Entity.php:34), reversible migrations with down() (database/migrations/2026_10_29_100000_create_entities_table.php:18), Blade components reused, docs/schema plus CHANGELOG updated; deviation: rules() at app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:208 instead of #[Validate], domain write inline rather than app/Actions

readability.evidence: Small focused methods (app/Tenancy/EntityLanding.php:639, app/Http/Middleware/EnsureCurrentEntity.php:130, app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:258), clear names matching sibling style, no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: entities_slug_unique plus soft deletes (database/migrations/2026_10_29_100000_create_entities_table.php:8), owner_seq generated column plus entity_memberships_one_owner and entity_user_unique (database/migrations/2026_10_29_100100_create_entity_memberships_table.php:47), Entity/EntityMembership/UserRole contract (app/Models/Entity.php:340, app/Models/EntityMembership.php:396, app/Models/UserRole.php:486), policies match spec, onboarding transaction plus UniqueConstraintViolationException retry plus audit log plus session plus redirect (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:224), pick 403-untouched plus audit (app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:58), home/middleware 0/1/>1 dispatch (app/Http/Controllers/HomeController.php:87, app/Http/Middleware/EnsureCurrentEntity.php:130), switcher buttons without tags (resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:983), navbar >1 only (resources/views/layouts/default-page.blade.php:1023), lang keys both locales (lang/pt_BR/ui.php:957)

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task (models, migrations, policies, onboarding, middleware, landing, switcher, dashboard, routes, langs, schema docs); no members/settings pages, no locale middleware, no navbar redesign, no invitations/queues/billing

security.evidence: Input validated before persist (app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:217), Dashboard authorizes view (app/Livewire/Entity/Dashboard.php:305), pick and middleware abort 403 on non-membership before session write (app/Http/Controllers/EntityController.php:58, app/Http/Middleware/EnsureCurrentEntity.php:140), output escaped via {{ }} (resources/views/entity/switcher.blade.php:983), mass-assignment via Fillable; gap: no Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware for current_entity (bootstrap/app.php:708, routes/web.php:1089) and no authorize in submit

simplicity.evidence: Shared EntityLanding.resolve reused by HomeController and middleware (app/Tenancy/EntityLanding.php:639), minimal TenantContext holder (app/Tenancy/TenantContext.php:674), no service/repository layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityTest.php covers second-owner rejection (1128), unique membership (1142), policy matrices (1171,1190), home dispatch (1232,1236,1246), deleted entity (1255), dashboard 403s (1280,1289,1297), pick audit plus 403-untouched (1306,1320), switcher markup plus navbar (1332,1354), onboarding locales/validation/owner/slugs/retry (1370,1378,1385,1405,1418); missing explicit Livewire unauthorized-call test for submit

review.summary: Implements the full entities data model, policies, tenant session, onboarding, switcher and dashboard per the contract with strong edge-case handling and broad Pest coverage. Minor gaps only: rules() instead of #[Validate], no persistent Livewire middleware for current_entity, no Livewire unauthorized-call test, and a duplicated changelog line.
